messages:
Maria: Thanks for joining the runtime roadmap Q&A. Dropping a quick live thread for items we didn’t get to and follow-ups for leadership. Add anything missing here.

CTO-Bot: Hi all 4bb Quick note from leadership: priorities are (1) stabilize p95 under bursty traffic, (2) reduce per-token cost via batching + cache, (3) land safe quantization path.

Jules: To expand: kernel team is doing a two-track approach  will land hotfixes for slow attention paths this sprint, while engineers prototype "staged fusion" that composes small kernels into larger ops without a full compiler.

Sam: Can you define "staged fusion" more concretely? What metrics will signal we can flip it on?

Jules: Good q. Staged fusion = runtime-level operator chaining + lightweight codegen for the fused path. Signal: <5% throughput regression on representative models, p95 no worse than baseline, and memory < +10%. We'll publish a checklist.

Kara: Are we expecting any SDK/consumer changes? e.g., will model outputs or tokenization have behavioral differences?

Ravi: No token-level changes. There may be new SDK flags to control batch smoothing and cache prefetching. Default will be backward-compatible.

Priya: For dedicated customers on older hardware, how do we avoid surprises when fused kernels land?

Jules: Plan: hardware capability detection + graceful fallback. We won't enable fused kernels by default on older GPUs; we'll gate by a checksum/version check and provide canary images.

Ethan: Leadership: what's the rough timeline for turning on predictive KV prefetching? Will it add extra memory pressure?

Maria: Prefetching target is experimental in Q3. We expect modest memory increase; we'll add a tunable `kv.prefetch_limit` and monitor OOM rates.

Sam: Can we get a new perf dashboard showing per-model p50/p95/p99 and batch-size distribution? Current dashboard is too coarse.

Priya: +1 on that. Also want a dashboard for KV hit/miss by route.

Jules: I'll own dashboards. Will add per-model latency histograms, batch-size heatmap, and kv hit/miss charts to the runtime console. ETA: first pass in 2 weeks.

CTO-Bot: Leadership asks for an explicit rollback plan for each major rollout. Please include test signals and auto-fallback thresholds.

Ravi: We'll add a rollout manifest to each PR: `rollback_on: p95 > baseline*1.10 OR kv_miss_rate > baseline + 0.05` format. Example in draft PR: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RUNTIME-2248

Kara: Small feature ask from product: add `batch_size_hint` and `latency_budget_ms` to the SDK so teams can declare latency intent per request.

Jules: We can add both. Server will enforce an upper-bound to prevent starvation. Example proto: `{"batch_size_hint": 4, "latency_budget_ms": 120}`. We'll include in SDK v0.9-beta.

Priya: How will canarying work for customers who are privacy-sensitive and run Private deployments?

Maria: For Private deployments we’ll provide build artifacts and rollout guides; no telemetry leaves the cluster unless customer opts in. We'll do scheduled maintenance windows for these upgrades.

Sam: Action items I can pick up: populate eval suite with 20 short-context p95 prompts and 10 long-context mem-stress prompts.

Jules: Action: I'll share the kernel landing checklist + draft PR with perf regression tests by Fri EOD.

Ravi: Action: autoscaler changes to include queue-aware soft-scaling, PR draft by next Wed.

Maria: Leadership note: we need a clear customer comms plan before Q3 experiments. @Priya can you draft an email template + docs page?

Priya: Yep, I'll draft a customer-facing FAQ + migration notes and post here for review by Thu.

meeting-bot: Slides and full recording uploaded: https://meetings.redwood.ai/rec/1793001234 ; quick clip: runtime kernels 00:22:00-00:40:00

Kara: thanks all. If anyone wants to pair on the SDK flags I can help.

Maria: Thanks team. I'll compile minutes and distribute. If there are follow-ups for leadership, DM me. :v:
